title: Circadian Temperature Drop, Glymphatic Clearance & Deep-Work Timing
summary: Core body temperature drops by ~1.0 °C to initiate slow-wave NREM sleep, driving glymphatic metabolic clearance before REM dream consolidation peaks in the final two sleep cycles.
takeaways: Distal vasodilation (warm shower 60–90 min pre-bed) accelerates sleep-onset latency without blunting deep sleep. || Protecting a consistent wake anchor (±30 min) stabilizes cortisol/adenosine timing for morning deep-work blocks. || Cross-check against Sleep_and_Dream_Log.txt dream recall polarity on ≥8.0 h vs. <6.5 h nights.

title: Savings Margin vs. Liquid Runway as Privacy-Safe Personal KPIs
summary: Dimensionless ratios—net savings margin (% of post-tax inflow), liquid runway (months of fixed expenses), and indexed net-worth velocity (base = 100)—capture financial trajectory cleanly on a public dashboard without exposing raw account balances.
takeaways: Track monthly fixed-cost floor vs. discretionary variance (%) alongside TFSA/FHSA contribution cadence. || Compute cost-per-hour-of-use on major hardware, athletic, and gaming purchases.

title: Frame Advantage, Disjointed Hitboxes & Matchup Volatility in Smash Ultimate
summary: Comparing sword/disjoint archetypes (Byleth, Link, Young Link, Sephiroth) against heavy punish archetypes (Ridley, King Dedede, Bowser) explains why stage control and out-of-shield frame data dominate 1v1 King-of-the-Hill streaks.
takeaways: Byleth and Young Link convert spacing traps into consistent stock leads across both Next Smash Mains and 1v1 Series logs. || Matchup multiplier 1 - (MU / 20) rewards winning uphill disadvantage states without over-penalizing close last-hit losses.
